sourceMaterials.title: Samuel Adeyemi — working CV
sourceMaterials.content: Samuel Adeyemi. BSc Geography and Environmental Science, Obafemi Awolowo University, 2020–2025. The working CV reports a 4.10/5.00 CGPA, but this figure was copied before final moderation. Data fellow at CivicMap Nigeria, February–November 2024, alongside final-year study; freelance geospatial analyst, August 2024–present. Projects combine satellite imagery, public-health access and community interviews. One conference abstract was submitted in May 2026; acceptance has not been announced. Nigerian citizen living in Abuja.

sourceMaterials.title: Unofficial incomplete academic record
sourceMaterials.content: Unofficial student copy dated 30 May 2025. Cumulative GPA shown as 4.08/5.00 before final project moderation. Final project grade and degree completion date are blank. The record states ‘not a final transcript’. Courses include GIS, Remote Sensing, Epidemiology for Geographers, Statistics and Qualitative Methods.

sourceMaterials.title: Employment chronology
sourceMaterials.content: CivicMap Nigeria data fellowship, 5 February–30 November 2024, 20 hours per week while enrolled full-time. Freelance geospatial analysis, 1 August 2024–present, variable hours. No employer from December 2024–present besides freelance work. Current address: 21 Gimbiya Street, Abuja, Nigeria. Permanent address: 9 Oke-Ila Road, Ile-Ife, Nigeria.

sourceMaterials.title: Available referees
sourceMaterials.content: Only professional referees are currently confirmed: Fatima Musa, CivicMap programme manager, and Dr Peter Obi, public-health project lead. Samuel has not yet asked an academic lecturer and has not supplied an academic referee’s contact details.

sourceMaterials.title: Applicant clarification notes
sourceMaterials.content: I want an interdisciplinary master’s in geospatial data and public health. I do not know my final CGPA or the official date my degree requirements were completed. I need to request a final transcript. I have not had a disciplinary case. Funding is desirable but I could begin without a full award.
